name: Lightpanda · Keep every version of a terms page
alt: Animated infographic on white: Lightpanda, Massive and your code listed in a stack card, then the machine. A daily schedule runs a Lightpanda fetch of example.com/terms; the request goes out through a Massive residential IP and the page comes back as Markdown; a word diff marks the changed wording in red; a webhook rings; and the dated copy drops into an archive of daily versions. Packets move through several steps at once. Headline: Keep every version of a terms page.
